# NeuromorphicPointCloudAdapter

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A lightweight trainable module inserted into a frozen spiking backbone to adapt it for point cloud tasks without full fine-tuning. Reduces training cost and catastrophic forgetting, enabling scalable deployment of specialized point cloud SNNs across diverse TCC edge nodes.
